7. Restricting an erased Customer from a card read before its erasure is
   refused as stale, not as erased.
   Shows A04-1, A04-5. [witness: verification:registry_a04_erased_customer_stale_before_erased]
statements:
```text
answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
  r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
  accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
```

verdicts.why: The check establishes that the Customer has been erased and has no revision, then submits the pre-erasure revision and requires a stale refusal at stage 5. Its no-revision control reaches the erased lifecycle refusal at stage 6, demonstrating the required first-failing-check order, while the final assertions verify no state change.
